text: The Bidder shall hold a valid LUSA qualification for the relevant trade.
The Bidder shall employ at least 20 HVAC (LVI) professionals in its own workforce.
The Bidder shall hold an F-gas regulation qualification where the work involves refrigeration or air-conditioning equipment.
The Bidder shall hold a valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate at the time the quotation is submitted.
The Bidder shall have at least one reference project with a value of at least EUR 300,000.
The Bidder shall employ at least 15 electrical professionals in its own workforce.
Occupational safety plan -- describe the occupational safety plan covering maintenance work across the multi-tenant estate.
Warranty period for installed equipment -- state the warranty period offered on equipment and materials installed.
Regulatory compliance of lift maintenance -- describe how statutory lift inspection and maintenance obligations will be met and documented for the estate's goods and passenger lifts.
Waste management and sorting of waste on site -- describe how waste generated during maintenance work will be sorted and managed.
Spare parts availability and delivery time -- state typical lead times for common spare parts and the approach for discontinued equipment.
Quality control and testing procedures -- describe internal quality control and testing procedures for completed work.
Environmental management during works -- describe how environmental impacts will be managed during maintenance and repair work.
Inspection of the condition of the building envelope -- describe how the condition of roofing, cladding, and building fabric across the four buildings will be assessed.
Content and scheduling of maintenance visits -- state the proposed content and frequency of scheduled maintenance visits.
Access control and security at the Buyer's premises -- describe how site-access and security procedures will be observed across the tenanted buildings.
Reporting practice to the Buyer -- describe how maintenance activity and outstanding items will be reported to the Buyer's facilities contact.
Response time for fault situations and on-call arrangement -- state the proposed response time by severity category and describe out-of-hours cover.
Handover of the asset register and documentation -- describe how the existing asset register and technical documentation will be received and maintained.
Response times for corrective maintenance -- state proposed response times for corrective (non-emergency) maintenance requests.
Training of the Buyer's property staff -- describe training that will be provided to the Buyer's own facilities staff on maintained systems.
Subcontracting management plan -- describe how any subcontracted trades will be selected and supervised.
Escalation procedure for unresolved faults -- describe the escalation path for a fault not resolved within the agreed response time.
Bonus-malus scheme -- describe the bonus-malus arrangement proposed for over- and under-performance against agreed service levels.
Price indexation clause -- state the index proposed for annual price adjustment and the reference month for calculating adjustments.
Payment terms -- confirm acceptance of the payment terms set out in this request and its annexes.
Invoicing frequency and format -- state proposed invoicing frequency and confirm electronic invoicing capability.
Contract termination terms -- set out the notice periods and grounds for termination the Bidder proposes.
Pricing structure (fixed price / unit price / time-based charging) -- set out the proposed pricing structure.
Pricing currency -- all prices shall be quoted in euro.
Reference form (Liite 2) -- to be completed and enclosed, listing the reference project(s) relied upon to satisfy Section 2.
Certificate of pension insurance payments.
Certificate of tax payment.
Description of the quality system.
The minimum font size used in the quotation document shall be 11 pt.
The Bidder shall state the delivery channel and number of copies in which the quotation is to be submitted.
Quotations shall note the time zone and closing time given for the submission deadline in Section 7.
All framework pricing shall be expressed in euro as the reference currency.
All monetary figures shall be rounded to two decimal places.
Qualification requirements for personnel on site -- list the trade qualifications and site-induction requirements personnel will hold when working across the tenanted buildings.
Method statement for installation works -- provide a method statement for installation and replacement work that minimises disruption to tenants' operations.
Maintenance of refrigeration equipment (F-gas) -- describe the approach to F-gas-regulated maintenance of any refrigeration or cooling equipment serving the shared systems.
Content of the HVAC system maintenance agreement -- describe the scope and frequency of scheduled HVAC maintenance proposed for the shared systems.
Continuity of service through staff changes -- describe how continuity of service will be maintained if key maintenance personnel leave or are reassigned.
Periodic inspection of electrical installations -- describe the programme for statutory periodic inspection of electrical installations across the estate.
Fire protection system maintenance -- describe the approach to scheduled testing and maintenance of fire protection systems across the four buildings.
Access to tenanted areas requires at least 48 hours' notice to the relevant tenant except in emergency response situations.
Discount structure for framework agreement volume -- propose a discount structure applicable as order volumes increase over the contract period.
Contractual penalty for shortfall in service level -- describe the Bidder's position on a contractual penalty applying where agreed service levels are not met.
Prices for the shared-system maintenance scope shall be quoted in EUR per square metre per year, not in EUR per month.
Prices quoted shall remain valid for 90 days from the closing date given in Section 7 of the main request.
Confidentiality undertaking, signed by an authorised representative of the Bidder.
Power of attorney for the person signing the quotation on the Bidder's behalf, where that person is not a registered signatory of the Bidder.
Trade register extract, issued no earlier than three months before the closing date.
